units.en: As Germany with a female leader either annex the USA, including Alaska and Hawaii or have an American puppet that owns all the American starting states, including Alaska and Hawaii.

Follow the HRE (Holy Roman Empire) strategy. Start and win the German Civil War. Make sure the Hindenburg survives by taking the ⟦0⟧ decision and go down the path to return the Kaiser. The ⟦1⟧ needs to block the return of the Kaiser event, which can be achieved by making your army smaller than the Dutch army (you can simply delete all army units), then select the option to make Wilhelm III your leader.

Improve relations with the ⟦0⟧ by going through the focus ⟦1⟧ and take decisions ⟦2⟧ (100 pp) and ⟦3⟧ (150 pp). This is done ostensibly to allow Wilhelm III's granddaughters to succeed (although, given that Wilhelm III's eldest son is, at that point, still in his early 30's, this pretext is flimsy.) After this a decision will appear to reinstate the royal titles.
Reinstate Prince Wilhelm's Right of Succession

Select the option to send Victoria Louise as liaison, which will prompt the event ⟦0⟧ which makes Victoria the Kaiserin and leader of your country. From that point do what you can to invade the ⟦1⟧, possibly by taking the ⟦2⟧ focus to take out ⟦3⟧, which will give staging grounds around the ⟦4⟧ for future invasions (by capitulating France, you get three islands in the Caribbean and a tiny island off the coast of Canada.) You should be guaranteed by the ⟦5⟧ so you can also justify on France directly. Don't forget to take French navy when you capitulate them (it's twice the size of your own, and will be a lot of help when dealing with the U.S. navy.) You can also easily take out Netherlands, getting even more navy and one more Caribbean island.

WARNING: the Anglo-German Defense Pact does ⟦0⟧ remove the UK or the Allies from the equation. The USA can still join the Allies, bringing the UK into war against you (and, to make things even more exciting while all your divisions are busy fighting in Texas, they can then call in ⟦1⟧, too.) Plan accordingly.

Go through the historical ⟦0⟧ path but you need to trigger 2 blunders with Hitler as leader. These blunders are the claim on Memel and Demand Sudetenland focuses. It is best to early rush the Allies so you have ⟦1⟧ capitulated and a landing already established in the ⟦2⟧.

For ⟦0⟧, justify a war goal on them while at war with the Allies so they will pick up a guarantee. Declare war but don't push, then take the ⟦1⟧ focus. Being in the Allies they will refuse handing over Memel and this will be the first blunder. You can take them out once they refuse.

For ⟦0⟧, take the ⟦1⟧ focus and justify a war goal which should only take 10 days due to being at war with the Allies, and they should be guaranteed by the ⟦2⟧. Once the focus finishes, they should refuse to hand over the land which will be the second blunder.

From this point you can capitulate the ⟦0⟧ quickly as the event to overthrow Hitler can happen within 6 months and you want to be at peace before this. You can additionally justify war goals to increase the land you can take in the ⟦1⟧ peace deal to include anyone else you want in Europe. Once at peace, it is best to change your army to a 1 battalion anti-air division to weaken the enemy in the coming civil war. When the ⟦2⟧ event triggers, select the second option "Perhaps his removal would be for the best". The next event should fire that the conspiracy succeeded, at which point you can select Eva Braun in the 4th option to lead the country. ⟦3⟧ will start a civil war, but this should be trivial to win as you have changed the templates. Change your army back to a proper template or a small cavalry template to take victory points faster. You can call in other Axis members to assist you in the civil war.

Once you finish the civil war, take everything including the navy and you are then set to invade the ⟦0⟧ (using ⟦1⟧ as a staging ground). You should be able to declare war before ⟦2⟧ attacks the ⟦3⟧, which should mean they haven't built up much of an army, and you have the combined fleets of all conquered nations from the Allies. Make a collaboration government so you don't have to walk troops all the way across the ⟦4⟧. Once finished, you can decide to annex or puppet them, and take their navy if you are going for anything else in the run.
